Coconut red lentils with rice

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

Creamy split lentils and spinach make a mild topping for warm rice.

South Asian-inspired · dinner, bowl · easy

Servings: 2

Prep: 10 min

Cook: 25 min

Total: 35 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 4 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: No listed major allergens. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 3/4 cup dry split red lentils (Rinsed; gluten-free labelled if needed. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1/2 cup canned unsweetened coconut milk (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 2 cups water
  • 2 cups ready-cooked rice (Use a fresh sealed plain rice pouch or rice promptly chilled and refrigerated. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 2 cups baby spinach
  • 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
  • 2 teaspoons fresh ginger (grated)
  • 1/4 teaspoon fine salt

Cooking instructions

  1. Combine the dry split red lentils, water, ground turmeric and fresh ginger in a saucepan. Bring to a simmer.
  2. Cook partly covered on low for 18–20 minutes, stirring often until the lentils are very soft.
  3. Stir in the canned unsweetened coconut milk, fine salt and baby spinach and simmer for 3 minutes until creamy.
  4. Heat the ready-cooked rice according to its package to 74°C/165°F and spoon the lentils over it.
